**Finding: Compliant — no redline proposed.**

The document contains no MFN obligation burdening us. Details:

- **§1.8 (p0013–p0014)** is the only "no less favorably" undertaking, and it runs **in our favour**: HDI must promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favorably than its own catalog titles, including inclusion in HDI's Xoom.com and Excite promotion calendars, with HDI bearing promotion costs. Per the rule's detection guidance, a Vendor-granted MFN is marked compliant and left untouched.
- **§3 Fees (p0019–p0022)** is a flat 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold — no benchmarking, price-matching, or best-terms mechanic that could pull in third-party terms.
- **§7.1 Cross-Promotions (p0044)** is mutual and framed as "reciprocal and equitable," with each party retaining approval rights — a reciprocity covenant, not an MFN.
- **§6 Exclusivity (p0037–p0042)** restricts the field of activity rather than requiring us to extend HDI any better terms given to others; §6.3 in fact restricts HDI. (Exclusivity scope is a separate playbook rule and outside this MFN check.)

No walk-away or fallback analysis was needed, since there is no open-ended obligation to pass through third-party terms.
